name: Alexander Bernhuber, Anna Strolenberg - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on ensuring the faster registration and uptake of biological control agents
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to make it faster and easier to approve biological pest control products — products based on natural organisms or substances rather than chemicals. It wants a clear EU-wide legal definition, quicker approval procedures, longer approval periods for low-risk products, and more money and staff for the bodies that assess them. It also asks for better advice and training for farmers. This is the Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to propose faster approval rules and a legal definition.
- **Who it affects:** Farmers, small biocontrol companies, and EU and national safety assessors.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to propose a targeted revision of the pesticide approval rules.
